findings.evidence: The first digest lists 463 removed units and shows 40; the cut list is one finding.
findings.fix: Restore any substantive unit from the unshown remainder into references/ (a template, procedure or tested example) or add a record row for it in docs/audit/recovery/meme-factory/record.md.

findings.evidence: Building blocks restates fences, blockquotes, hard breaks and horizontal rules that current models already produce for Markdown.
findings.fix: Keep the non-obvious setext trap and the greentext-fence rule in SKILL.md's load path; move the rest of this known-Markdown tutorial to the end of references/text-memes.md only if users ask for the technique by name, and record any deletion.

findings.evidence: Step 1 loads markdown-memes-guide.md for every text-only request, then text-memes.md for any of 15 formats, so both files load together with no Do NOT Load gate.
findings.fix: Name one file per request: read references/text-memes.md only for a named format, and Do NOT Load references/markdown-memes-guide.md once that file is open; keep the guide for greentext, copypasta and ASCII only.

findings.evidence: Format 11's sample renders as replacement boxes (four runs of U+FFFD) instead of the emoji the tips depend on.
findings.fix: Restore the original emoji sample (walking away, coffee, target, sparkles) into that fenced block so the format is usable when loaded.

findings.evidence: Step 5 tells the agent to compare caption count with lines, but generate accepts any count and the skill names no per-template line source for IDs outside the table.
findings.fix: Before generate, run a live check of https://api.memegen.link/templates/<id> (or list-templates) and pass exactly that many captions; have the helper reject a count that does not match a known template's lines.

findings.evidence: Several evals name files under references/ that are instructions, not inputs, and evals/files/ does not exist; trigger queries have 12 should-trigger and 10 should-not-trigger.
findings.fix: Drop the instruction-file entries from files (or add real inputs under evals/files/), and add near-miss should-not-trigger queries until the split is about 10 and 10.

findings.evidence: The complete post example's Success Metrics lines are the same replacement characters (U+FFFD) as text-memes.md format 11, so the worked post cannot be copied.
findings.fix: Put the original emoji back on those three lines (target, sparkles, the third glyph from the baseline sample) and keep the curl-checked image URLs.

findings.evidence: The escape table's worked row says a double quote is written as '' and an apostrophe as ', while _format_text leaves apostrophes raw and the tests pin that.
findings.fix: Change the apostrophe cell to ' (left as-is) and add one hand-built example that shows a double quote becoming '' so the table matches the helper.

findings.evidence: Endpoints says the service needs no API key and keeps no state, but does not say whether normal use is rate limited.
findings.fix: Add one sourced line: either 'no documented rate limit for normal use' with the memegen README URL and the date checked, or an instruction to read the live docs before assuming unlimited calls.

findings.evidence: Gotchas covers double escaping, empty segments, line count, unconfirmed success and watermark, but not the helper's silent acceptance of the wrong number of captions.
findings.fix: Add a gotcha: never call generate with fewer or more captions than the template's lines, because the helper will still print a URL and the extra panel is lost or a blank one is invented.

findings.evidence: The workflow is a tool procedure with a small audience checklist, not a thinking frame for which joke form fits the channel.
findings.fix: Add three lines before step 3: text-only when the channel cannot preview images, image when it can, and name the payoff before picking a template.
